summary.en: "[P]eople are not familiar with this disease and don’t fully understand the potential severity."
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Two unvaccinated people have died from measles in Pennsylvania, state health officials confirmed Tuesday . They are the first measles deaths reported in Pennsylvania in 35 years and the first deaths reported in the US in 2026. Last year, the US saw three measles deaths : two in otherwise-healthy but unvaccinated school-age children in Texas and one in an unvaccinated adult in New Mexico. Prior to those deaths, the US had not seen a measles death since 2015 , when a woman with underlying conditions became severely ill. Citing privacy, health officials in Pennsylvania are not providing information on the people who died beyond that they were unvaccinated and were residents of Lancaster County. Officials noted that the deaths are among 393 confirmed cases reported this year across 28 counties in the state. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员周二证实，宾夕法尼亚州有两名未接种疫苗的人死于麻疹。这是宾夕法尼亚州 35 年来首次报告的麻疹死亡病例，也是美国 2026 年报告的第一例麻疹死亡病例。去年，美国发生了 3 例麻疹死亡事件：德克萨斯州有 2 例健康但未接种疫苗的学龄儿童，新墨西哥州有 1 例未接种疫苗的成年人。在此之前，美国自 2015 年一名患有基础疾病的女性病情严重以来，就没有出现过麻疹死亡事件。宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员以隐私为由，没有提供有关死者的信息，除了未接种疫苗且是兰开斯特县居民的信息。官员们指出，今年该州 28 个县报告了 393 例确诊病例，其中包括这些死亡病例。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Songs created by AI banned from Australia's music charts
title.zh: 澳大利亚音乐排行榜禁止人工智能创作的歌曲

summary.en: The move comes weeks after a DJ admitted using AI to remix a Madonna song that topped the Australian charts.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Songs that are largely or wholly created by AI have been banned from Australia's music charts.

The Australian Recording Industry Association (ARIA) said the new code would help "promote the human nature of artistry".

It follows a controversy around a cover of Madonna's Like A Prayer by Australian DJ Josh Fawaz which recently topped the ARIA dance singles chart and peaked at number 2 on the country's overall chart.

The song has become a staple of commercial radio station playlists and been streamed more than 48 million times on Spotify alone.

ARIA said that Australian artists were competing for attention "in the most crowded market in history" and that it was "not interested in promoting or celebrating the success of AI-generated music that does not contain human artistry".

Under the new rules, AI assistance can still be used, but humans must have written the song, and have performed the lead vocal and primary instruments.

AI can also still be used for mastering songs and, for example, using drum machines and auto tune.

Earlier this year a song was banned from Sweden's music charts because it was created by AI.

And in July, the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry (IFPI) said AI guidelines would be rolled out in Latin America, the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia for use in their official charts.

The updated code, based on the IFPI directive, also excludes music that raises "stream or chart manipulation concerns".

ARIA chief executive Annabelle Herd said: "These changes reflect our intent to remain dynamic and promote the human nature of artistry in what is, to say the least, a rapidly developing space."

"Artists already use AI tools in their work, the charts can and should evolve to keep room for that, but music generated wholesale by services built on artists' recordings is a different matter."

She added: "A chart that rewards unlicensed AI output would undercut the very basis of the recorded music we exist to represent."

Artists will be required to declare AI use when they submit a song for chart consideration.

ARIA said that if it later emerged music was largely AI-generated it could retrospectively adjust chart positions, and if the piece topped the charts, it may request that awards given for reaching Number One were returned.

Last month, they shared an AI-assisted version of their 2014 hit High on Instagram, captioned: "When you re-record your own song with AI so Australian radio will play it."

Band member Adam Hyde told Channel Nine's Today show that AI-generated music was "removing the human experience from life".

In July this year, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese promised "the strongest possible protection" from AI for Australian creatives.

body.zh: 大部分或完全由人工智能创作的歌曲已被禁止出现在澳大利亚音乐排行榜上。 澳大利亚唱片工业协会（ARIA）表示，新准则将有助于“促进艺术的人性化”。 此前，澳大利亚 DJ Josh Fawaz 翻唱了麦当娜的《Like A Prayer》引发争议，该歌曲最近登上了 ARIA 舞曲单曲榜榜首，并在该国总体排行榜上排名第二。 这首歌已成为商业广播电台播放列表的主要内容，仅在 Spotify 上的播放量就超过 4800 万次。 ARIA 表示，澳大利亚艺术家正在“在历史上最拥挤的市场”中争夺注意力，并且“对推广或庆祝不包含人类艺术性的人工智能生成音乐的成功不感兴趣”。 根据新规则，仍然可以使用人工智能辅助，但歌曲必须由人类创作，并演奏主唱和主要乐器。 人工智能仍然可以用于掌握歌曲，例如使用鼓机和自动调音。 今年早些时候，瑞典音乐排行榜禁止一首歌曲，因为它是由人工智能创作的。 7 月，国际唱片业联合会 (IFPI) 表示，人工智能指南将在拉丁美洲、中东、非洲和东南亚推出，用于其官方排行榜。 更新后的代码基于 IFPI 指令，还排除了引发“流媒体或图表操纵问题”的音乐。 ARIA 首席执行官安娜贝尔·赫德 (Annabelle Herd) 表示：“这些变化反映了我们在这个快速发展的领域保持活力并提升艺术人性的意图。” “艺术家已经在他们的工作中使用人工智能工具，图表可以而且应该不断发展以为此留出空间，但通过基于艺术家录音的服务批量生成的音乐是另一回事。” 她补充道：“奖励未经许可的人工智能输出的图表将削弱我们所代表的录制音乐的基础。” 艺术家在提交歌曲供排行榜考虑时将被要求声明人工智能的使用。 ARIA 表示，如果后来发现音乐主要是由人工智能生成的，它可以回顾性地调整排行榜位置，如果这首作品名列榜首，它可能会要求退回为达到第一名而颁发的奖项。 上个月，他们在 Instagram 上分享了 2014 年热门歌曲《High》的人工智能辅助版本，标题是：“当你用人工智能重新录制自己的歌曲时，澳大利亚电台就会播放它。” 乐队成员亚当·海德 (Adam Hyde) 在第九频道的《今日》节目中表示，人工智能生成的音乐正在“消除人类的生活体验”。 今年 7 月，澳大利亚总理 Anthony Albanese 承诺为澳大利亚创意人员提供“尽可能最强的保护”，使其免受人工智能的侵害。 阿尔巴尼斯承诺作家和音乐家将...

title.en: Sharing dangerous driving videos is 'truly reprehensible', PM says
title.zh: 总理表示，分享危险驾驶视频“确实应受到谴责”

summary.en: His comments come as the government urged TikTok and other social media firms to remove wrong-way driving videos.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The government has urged social media companies to remove posts celebrating dangerous driving, as Prime Minister Andy Burnham branded sharing them "truly reprehensible".

Earlier Defence Minister Luke Pollard told BBC Breakfast that "social media companies could take the content down easily and adjust their algorithms to stop it being distributed".

Two police officers died when a car going the wrong way down a dual carriageway crashed into their vehicle near Middlesbrough on Saturday. Five passengers in the other car were also killed.

A TikTok account believed to belong to one of the five passengers, 18-year-old Makai Saddington, previously shared videos appearing to show dangerous driving, which have since been removed.

But Cleveland Police said "there is no evidence to indicate that filming of the activities that took place on Friday night and Saturday morning has taken place for the purposes of TikTok".

Pollard said the government had "already taken steps" to tell social media companies to take down such content.

He added: "They know exactly what content is on their site, they know how their algorithm works.

"They also know that people post content to get views and the more views you get, sometimes you get money for it, so it's a financial incentive to post outrageous content that gets more people watching it."

Speaking to reporters in Kyiv, Burnham said the people who share footage glorifying dangerous driving are "doing something that's truly reprehensible".

A Downing Street spokeswoman said "the glorification of dangerous driving for clips and entertainment is utterly disgraceful".

She added that the culture secretary has been clear that footage should be removed by social media platforms "in line with their legal obligations", and that Ofcom has the government's "full backing to take action" against those that fail in their duties.

Video content featuring illegal activity is not necessarily illegal itself - according to the Online Safety Act - it is up to the social network to decide whether flagged content is illegal and act accordingly.

TikTok said its policies prohibit content that could cause significant physical harm, including dangerous driving.

It added that it is actively removing videos and accounts that break its rules, including the account believed to belong to Saddington.

The company said between January and March 2026, 99.8% of the content removed for violating those policies it took down proactively.

While TikTok is taking some videos down, it is not necessarily because it has deemed them to be illegal - it may only be because they breach the firm's own terms and conditions.

There are specific exceptions which are set out in the Online Safety Act, but they can be difficult to interpret.

title.en: Twitch and Amazon face legal action over using livestreams to train AI
title.zh: Twitch 和亚马逊因使用直播训练人工智能而面临法律诉讼

summary.en: The lawsuit alleges Twitch used streamers' videos to train AI without their permission or proper compensation.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Amazon is facing a lawsuit , external over its move to train its AI models on videos people broadcast on the popular streaming platform Twitch.

The move faced backlash from users when it was announced in August - with people having the option to opt-out if they do not want their data used this way.

The class action lawsuit has been brought on behalf of millions of streamers who use Twitch, alleging its parent company Amazon used their videos to train AI without their permission or proper compensation.

Streamers on the platform reportedly produced , external more than 215 million hours of content in the first few months of 2026 alone.

It claims Twitch breached its contract with users by using that content as AI training data for Amazon's models without obtaining their permission.

It adds streamers should not have their work commercially exploited to develop AI without consent or compensation.

The lawsuit seeks damages for streamers whose content was allegedly used to train AI, as well as an order preventing Amazon from continuing the alleged practice.

It is not clear when Amazon began collecting Twitch users' data to train its AI models.

Twitch's chief product officer Mike Minton previously said he did not know if users' data had been scraped for training before it gave people the opportunity to opt-out.

He said he was unsure what Amazon "has done in terms of model training and what they've used and not used".

In Twitch's own FAQs about AI training, it said a person's audio might be used to "refine models that create speech to text".

It said this would help improve automatic subtitles on Twitch streams as well as Amazon videos.

Those that want to disable the feature would need to navigate to the Settings tab in their Streamer Dashboard, click the Security and Privacy tab, then scroll down to near the bottom of the options and toggle off "training for Generative AI".

However, the opt-out only applies to individual streams, meaning creators' content could still be used for AI training when they appear in a stream where the feature remains enabled.

Amazon, which bought Twitch for nearly $1bn (£740m) in 2014, has made AI a major focus as it competes with Google, Meta and other tech giants.

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .
body.zh: 亚马逊因在流行的流媒体平台 Twitch 上播放的视频来训练其人工智能模型而面临外部诉讼。 此举在 8 月份宣布时遭到了用户的强烈反对，如果人们不希望自己的数据以这种方式使用，他们可以选择退出。 该集体诉讼是代表数百万使用 Twitch 的主播提起的，指控其母公司亚马逊在未经许可或适当补偿的情况下使用他们的视频来训练人工智能。 据报道，仅 2026 年前几个月，该平台上的流媒体就制作了超过 2.15 亿小时的内容。 它声称 Twitch 在未经用户许可的情况下将这些内容用作亚马逊模型的人工智能训练数据，违反了与用户的合同。 它还补充说，未经同意或补偿，主播不应将其作品用于商业用途以开发人工智能。 该诉讼要求对内容据称被用来训练人工智能的流媒体造成损害，并要求下令阻止亚马逊继续其所谓的做法。 目前尚不清楚亚马逊何时开始收集 Twitch 用户数据来训练其人工智能模型。 Twitch 的首席产品官迈克·明顿 (Mike Minton) 此前表示，他不知道用户的数据是否已被抓取用于培训，然后才给人们选择退出的机会。 他表示，他不确定亚马逊“在模型训练方面做了什么，以及他们使用了什么和没有使用什么”。 在 Twitch 自己的关于人工智能训练的常见问题解答中，它表示一个人的音频可能会被用来“完善创建语音到文本的模型”。 该公司表示，这将有助于改进 Twitch 流媒体和亚马逊视频的自动字幕。 想要禁用该功能的用户需要导航到 Streamer 仪表板中的“设置”选项卡，单击“安全和隐私”选项卡，然后向下滚动到选项底部附近并关闭“生成 AI 训练”。 然而，选择退出仅适用于单个流，这意味着当创作者的内容出现在该功能保持启用的流中时，仍然可以用于人工智能训练。 亚马逊于 2014 年以近 10 亿美元（7.4 亿英镑）的价格收购了 Twitch，在与谷歌、Meta 和其他科技巨头竞争时，已将人工智能作为主要焦点。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

body.en: Aug. 25 is a National Day of Action to support U.S. national parks and public lands. One focus of the event is the U.S. government’s intention to rescind a rule that bans road construction and industrial logging across more than 23 million hectares (57 million acres) of national forest land. The 2001 Roadless Rule, has helped protect some of the country’s most wild public lands, including Alaska’s Tongass National Forest, the world’s largest intact temperate rainforest and the ancestral homeland of several Indigenous peoples. “A rollback on the Roadless Rule means cultural genocide for our people,” Yolanda Fulmer of the Tlingit Indigenous nation and a Tongass representative with the California-based NGO Women Earth and Climate Action Network (WECAN), said in a statement. “Every part of our culture is intimately intertwined with the Tongass Forest, our traditional homelands.” The Tongass spans 6.8 million hectares (17 million acres) of mountains, rivers, rugged coastline and old-growth forest. Nicknamed “America’s Climate Forest,” the Tongass holds 20% of all the carbon stored in the country’s national forests and provides habitat for some 400 wildlife species including bears, wolves and moose. It also supports roughly 40% of North American bird species. If the Roadless Rule is rescinded, roughly 3.6 million hectares (9 million acres) of the Tongass could lose protections against new road development. Nationwide, 18 million hectares (45 million acres) of national forest system land could be affected. title.en: Indonesia charges 72 over fires as haze chokes Borneo and Sumatra
title.zh: 雾霾笼罩婆罗洲和苏门答腊岛，印度尼西亚因火灾指控 72 人

summary.en: Indonesian authorities have charged 72 individuals with intentionally igniting forest fires across five provinces on the island of Borneo and four on Sumatra. Fires across both islands have burned nearly 286,000 hectares (about 707,000 acres) of land from January to Aug. 24...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Indonesian authorities have charged 72 individuals with intentionally igniting forest fires across five provinces on the island of Borneo and four on Sumatra. Fires across both islands have burned nearly 286,000 hectares (about 707,000 acres) of land from January to Aug. 24 alone, according to FireWatch, a satellite-based monitoring tool developed by forest-mapping platform Nusantara Atlas. That’s an area half the size of the island of Bali. Officials say prolonged dry conditions and a powerful El Niño this year have severely worsened the wildfires. In a statement, local law enforcement alleged that the 72 suspects used fire to clear land in preparation for planting. Police seized lighters, fuel containers, machetes, axes, and samples of burned soil and tree trunks among various items of evidence. The smoke from the wildfires has caused choking haze clouds that have reduced visibility to just 10 meters (33 feet) in one province, according to the Associated Press. Mongabay previously reported that the fires have also caused hazardous air quality, and the destruction of vegetation has led to food shortages for wildlife like long-tailed macaques (Macaca fascicularis). The smoke has even drifted across the border to neighboring Malaysia. The wildfires have also affected critical conservation work, Mongabay previously reported. In Borneo’s West Kalimantan province, fires came close to an orangutan rehabilitation facility run by the nonprofit YIARI, where more than 60 critically endangered Bornean orangutans (Pongo pygmaeus) are housed after being rescued from the illegal wildlife trade and habitat loss. Meanwhile, the health toll is rising…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 印度尼西亚当局指控 72 人故意在婆罗洲岛的 5 个省份和苏门答腊岛的 4 个省份引发森林火灾。根据森林测绘平台 Nusantara Atlas 开发的卫星监测工具 FireWatch 的数据，仅从 1 月到 8 月 24 日，这两个岛屿的火灾就烧毁了近 286,000 公顷（约 707,000 英亩）的土地。这个面积有巴厘岛岛的一半大。官员们表示，长期干旱和今年强烈的厄尔尼诺现象使山火严重恶化。当地执法部门在一份声明中称，72 名嫌疑人用火清理土地，准备种植。警方缴获了打火机、燃料容器、砍刀、斧头、烧焦的土壤和树干样本等各种证据。据美联社报道，野火产生的烟雾造成令人窒息的雾霾，导致一个省的能见度降至仅 10 米（33 英尺）。 Mongabay此前报道称，火灾还导致空气质量恶化，植被破坏导致长尾猕猴等野生动物食物短缺。烟雾甚至越过边境飘到邻国马来西亚。 Mongabay 此前报道称，野火还影响了重要的保护工作。在婆罗洲西加里曼丹省，火灾发生在非营利组织 YIARI 运营的猩猩康复设施附近，那里安置了 60 多只因非法野生动物贸易和栖息地丧失而获救的极度濒危婆罗洲猩猩 (Pongo pygmaeus)。与此同时，健康死亡人数正在上升……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

title.en: Only 1,325-1,648 wild elephants left in Indonesia, government says
title.zh: 政府称印度尼西亚只剩下1,325-1,648头野生大象

summary.en: A new 10-year plan for elephant conservation released by the Indonesian government places the country’s wild elephant population at an estimated 1,325-1,648 individuals. The previous figure, published in 2007, was 2,400-2,800 individuals, meaning the new estimate represents a...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A new 10-year plan for elephant conservation released by the Indonesian government places the country’s wild elephant population at an estimated 1,325-1,648 individuals. The previous figure, published in 2007, was 2,400-2,800 individuals, meaning the new estimate represents a decline of 41-45%. The launch of the 2026-2036 strategy and action plan comes after a long wait. After the 2007-2017 elephant plan expired, the government was supposed to release a new one. While a draft 2019-2029 plan was completed in 2017, then-President Joko Widodo’s administration never finalized the plan or shared it with the public. The draft 2019-2029 plan, seen by Mongabay, placed Indonesia’s elephant population at just 928-1,379 individuals, Mongabay reported in 2022. The plans are drafted by the Indonesian Elephant Conservation Forum (FKGI), a multi-stakeholder group composed of conservationists from NGOs and government agencies, and submitted to the forestry ministry for approval. FKGI deputy head Wishnu Sukmantoro suggested the discrepancy between the new plan and the previous unreleased one was due to the incorporation of new data. “The higher figure [in 2026] doesn’t mean the elephant population has increased” since 2017, Wishnu told Mongabay. The updated number better represents the situation on the ground, he said. “It is a combination of scientific analysis and agreements among elephant conservationists.” Nearly all of Indonesia’s elephants are Sumatran elephants (Elephas maximus sumatranus), a critically endangered subspecies of the Asian elephant (Elephas maximus), which is itself endangered. Fewer than 52,000 Asian elephants are left, most of them in India, according to WWF. Indonesia’s new…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 印度尼西亚政府发布了新的大象保护十年计划，该国野生大象的数量估计为 1,325 至 1,648 头。 2007 年公布的上一数字为 2,400-2,800 人，这意味着新的估计减少了 41-45%。经过漫长的等待，2026-2036年战略和行动计划的发布。 2007-2017年大象计划到期后，政府本应发布新的大象计划。虽然 2019-2029 年计划草案已于 2017 年完成，但时任总统佐科维多多的政府从未最终确定该计划或与公众分享。 Mongabay 在 2022 年报道称，Mongabay 看到的 2019-2029 年计划草案显示，印度尼西亚的大象数量仅为 928-1,379 头。该计划由印度尼西亚大象保护论坛 (FKGI) 起草，该论坛是一个由非政府组织和政府机构的保护主义者组成的多利益相关者团体，并提交给林业部批准。 FKGI 副主任 Wishnu Sukmantoro 表示，新计划与之前未发布的计划之间的差异是由于纳入了新数据。 Wishnu 告诉 Mongabay，“[2026 年]更高的数字并不意味着自 2017 年以来大象数量有所增加”。他说，更新后的数字更好地反映了当地的情况。 “这是科学分析和大象保护主义者之间达成的协议的结合。”印度尼西亚的大象几乎全部都是苏门答腊象（Elephas maximus sumatranus），它是亚洲象（Elephas maximus）的极度濒危亚种，而亚洲象本身也濒临灭绝。据世界自然基金会称，亚洲象只剩下不到 52,000 头，其中大部分在印度。印度尼西亚的新…本文最初发表于 Mongabay

title.en: NSW’s koala national park will protect threatened species and cap logging across the state. Could the Greens really block it? | Adam Morton
title.zh: 新南威尔士州的考拉国家公园将保护受威胁的物种并限制全州的伐木活动。绿党真的能阻止吗？ |亚当·莫顿

summary.en: The Albanese government approved a proposal allowing the park to create carbon credits worth hundreds of millions of dollars, sparking a schism among environmentalists What qualifies as a win in environmental campaigning? Is it when a huge forest area that is home to a stack of...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Is it when a huge forest area that is home to a stack of threatened species, including koalas, and has been the focus of years and years of campaigning, is protected from logging?

Or does it depend on how the battle is won – for example, if it lets companies claim that the forest is helping cut their pollution?

It sounds like the start of a philosophical debate, but isn’t. It’s at the heart of a dispute dividing environment and climate activists, and is being weighed by the Greens ahead of a vote in the Senate next month.

In blunt terms, the minor party is considering whether to make an extraordinary call: to support a Nationals motion to strike down a Labor plan that would create a long-discussed great koala national park in northern New South Wales, and significantly reduce native forest logging in the state.

The vote was scheduled for last week but – in a sign of how vexed the issue has become – has been delayed until next month after the Greens asked the Nationals for more time to reach a consensus position.

In terms of a national political debate, the issue hasn’t had much of a look-in yet. But the ramifications could be substantial.

The story starts with a grassroots campaign to create a large park around Coffs Harbour to protect forests and more than a hundred threatened species, including koalas, gliders and glossy black cockatoos. That campaign is backed by a range of local campaigners and First Nations leaders.

NSW Labor signed up as a supporter more than a decade ago while in opposition. Under the premier, Chris Minns , it wasn’t until September 2025 that it announced it would add 176,000 hectares of state forest – an area more than twice the size of Canberra – to existing protected areas to create a 476,000 hectare reserve. It is said to protect about 12,000 koalas, water catchments and carbon stores.

The final confirmation that the park would go ahead didn’t come until June , when the Albanese government approved a NSW proposal that allows it to use the park to create carbon credits worth hundreds of millions of dollars.

Carbon credits remain opaque to most people, but they are the centre of the Australian government’s climate change policy. We need to explain why (bear with me here).

Each credit is said to represent one tonne of greenhouse gas emissions that has been prevented or drawn down from the atmosphere. In Australia, they most often come from projects that are meant to regenerate forests in the outback and capture and burn methane released from landfill sites.

The goal of the projects is sound. Regenerating forests is good! Cutting methane pollution is good! But the projects themselves have been sharply criticised.

Scientific studies have found major shortcomings with the main types of projects used in Australia and...
body.zh: 是不是当一片巨大的森林地区受到保护，免遭砍伐时，这里栖息着包括考拉在内的许多受威胁物种，并且多年来一直是运动的焦点？ 还是取决于这场战斗如何获胜——例如，是否可以让公司声称森林正在帮助减少污染？ 这听起来像是一场哲学辩论的开始，但事实并非如此。这是环境和气候活动人士之间争论的核心，绿党在下个月参议院投票之前正在权衡这一问题。 坦白说，这个小党正在考虑是否发出特别呼吁：支持国家党一项动议，否决一项工党计划，该计划将在新南威尔士州北部建立一个讨论已久的大考拉国家公园，并大幅减少该州的原生森林采伐。 投票原定于上周举行，但在绿党要求国民队有更多时间达成共识后，投票被推迟到下个月，这表明这个问题已经变得多么棘手。 就全国政治辩论而言，这个问题还没有得到太多关注。但其影响可能是巨大的。 故事始于一场草根运动，旨在在科夫斯港周围创建一个大型公园，以保护森林和一百多种受威胁的物种，包括考拉、滑翔机和光泽的黑色凤头鹦鹉。该活动得到了一系列当地活动人士和原住民领导人的支持。 新南威尔士州工党十多年前在反对党时期就加入了支持者行列。在州长克里斯·明斯 (Chris Minns) 的领导下，直到 2025 年 9 月，澳大利亚才宣布将在现有保护区的基础上增加 176,000 公顷的国家森林（面积是堪培拉面积的两倍多），以创建 476,000 公顷的保护区。据说它可以保护大约 12,000 只考拉、集水区和碳储存。 直到六月，阿尔巴尼亚政府才最终确认该公园将继续建设，当时阿尔巴尼亚政府批准了新南威尔士州的一项提案，允许其利用该公园创造价值数亿澳元的碳信用额。 碳信用额对大多数人来说仍然不透明，但它们是澳大利亚政府气候变化政策的核心。我们需要解释一下原因（请耐心听我说）。 据说每个信用额代表已被阻止或从大气中减少的一吨温室气体排放量。在澳大利亚，它们通常来自旨在再生内陆森林并捕获和燃烧垃圾填埋场释放的甲烷的项目。 这些项目的目标是合理的。恢复森林是好事！减少甲烷污染是好事！但这些项目本身却遭到了严厉批评。 科学研究发现澳大利亚使用的主要项目类型存在重大缺陷......

title.en: ‘I love rats but we can’t live with them’: the headache of rising rodent populations around the world
title.zh: “我爱老鼠，但我们无法与它们共存”：全球城市鼠患激增的难题

summary.en: Dr. Robert Corrigan, a renowned rodentologist, has spent his career studying the increasing rat populations in cities like New York. While acknowledging their intelligence and the livelihood they have provided him, he advocates for smarter, more effective solutions to manage the growing global infestation.
summary.zh: 著名啮齿动物学家罗伯特·科里根博士致力于研究纽约等城市日益严重的鼠患。在承认老鼠的聪明才智以及它们为他带来的生计的同时，他主张采取更明智、更有效的方案来应对全球范围内不断增长的鼠类侵扰。

body.en: Robert Corrigan has been dealing with the ‘smart’ rodents all his life – and believes there are better solutions to deal with the growing infestation in the world’s cities “The rodents have paid for every single bill I’ve ever had – every mortgage, every car payment, every pint of Guinness,” says Dr Robert Corrigan. “It’s been a great ride and I’m still at it.” New York-based Corrigan is one of the most respected voices in the world of rodentology. Now in his 70s, he has devoted his entire adult life to studying rats and our relationship with them. Continue reading...
body.zh: 罗伯特·科里根 (Robert Corrigan) 一生都在与“聪明”的啮齿动物打交道，他相信有更好的解决方案来应对世界城市中日益严重的鼠害问题。“啮齿类动物为我支付的每一笔账单都付了钱——每笔抵押贷款、每笔汽车付款、每一品脱吉尼斯黑啤酒，”罗伯特·科里根博士说。 “这是一次很棒的旅程，我仍然坚持下去。”总部位于纽约的科里根是啮齿动物学界最受尊敬的声音之一。现年 70 多岁的他将整个成年生活都奉献给了研究老鼠以及我们与它们的关系。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Dr. Corrigan’s 70-year career reminds us that even creatures we consider pests possess a complex intelligence that demands our attention and understanding. By 'asking the animals,' we move beyond simple eradication toward a more sophisticated stewardship of our urban environments. This perspective encourages us to see the natural world not just as a problem...
reflection.zh: 科里根博士七十年的职业生涯提醒我们，即使是那些被我们视为害虫的生物，也拥有复杂的智慧，值得我们去关注和理解。通过“询问走兽”，我们不再仅仅追求简单的消灭，而是转向对城市环境进行更成熟的管理。这种视角鼓励我们将自然界不仅看作是一个待解决的问题，更是一位揭示雅伟创造之奥秘的老师。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Bomb Fishing Is Wreaking Havoc on Indonesia's Coral Reefs
title.zh: 炸弹捕鱼对印度尼西亚的珊瑚礁造成严重破坏

summary.en: Fishers operating off the coast of Sulawesi, Indonesia, are detonating more than 8,000 underwater explosives each year, researchers estimate. The practice is turning picturesque coral reefs to “rubble.” Read more on E360 →
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article was originally published by Inside Climate News and is reproduced here as part of the Climate Desk collaboration.

Fishers operating off the coast of Sulawesi, Indonesia, are detonating more than 8,000 underwater explosives each year, researchers estimate. The practice is turning picturesque coral reefs to “rubble.”

Nicknamed the “Amazon of the Seas,” the Coral Triangle is the world’s most biologically diverse marine ecosystem. Sink below the surface and you’ll encounter the sound of a vibrant symphony of snapping shrimp, crunching crustaceans, and feeding fish.

But then the rhythmic music of life will dissolve into eerie silence, punctured only by the plosive boom of detonating bombs.

Off the coast of Indonesia’s Spermonde Archipelago, underwater microphones captured over 3,500 explosions in just 3,600 hours of recording, according to researchers from the Zoological Society of London.

The source? Blast fishing — a globally banned technique that uses plastic bottles packed with explosives to stun and kill everything in a 90-foot radius. The highly destructive practice has been documented in at least 34 countries, from Lebanon and Libya to Brazil and Ecuador.

While fishers predominantly use the method to catch fish for sale at local markets — identifiable by their ruptured internal organs and burst swim bladders — it’s also a grave threat to colorful coral reef habitats.

“Bomb fishing is quite likely the leading cause of reef loss in this area,” said Ben Williams, the paper’s lead author, noting that a single bomb can wreak 200 square feet of destruction. “These picturesque reefs get converted into a landscape that looks like the moon. It’s just rubble and dead coral with very little sign of life.”

In 2023, researchers from Britain and Indonesia snorkeled down and anchored $150 audio recorders to short stakes in the seafloor. Using A.I. software — which the team has now made open-source — they scoured 16 months of audio in just a few hours to identify possible detonations.

While the A.I. filtered suspected cases, each suggested sound wave was then manually verified to assess if it stemmed from a bomb or a misfiring boat engine.

With sound traveling over four times faster through water than air, the team of marine scientists were able to detect detonations from over 10 miles away.

“When [the bombs] are close, it’s so loud that it can shake you out of your skin,” said Williams. “But if you put your head up on the surface, you probably can’t even see the boat that did it.”

Accounting for stormy-season setbacks and spearfishermen who tampered with the recorders, the team calculated that there were likely more than 8,500 blasts each year — all within an area of just 350 square miles.

body.zh: 本文最初由《内部气候新闻》发表，并作为气候台合作的一部分转载于此。 研究人员估计，在印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛海岸作业的渔民每年会引爆 8,000 多枚水下炸药。这种做法正在将风景如画的珊瑚礁变成“瓦砾”。 珊瑚三角区被誉为“海洋亚马逊”，是世界上生物多样性最丰富的海洋生态系统。沉入水面以下，您会听到虾虾、甲壳类动物咀嚼和鱼儿喂食的充满活力的交响乐声。 但随后，生命的节奏音乐将消失在令人毛骨悚然的寂静中，只有炸弹爆炸的爆炸声刺破这一切。 据伦敦动物学会的研究人员称，在印度尼西亚斯佩蒙德群岛海岸附近，水下麦克风在短短 3,600 小时的记录中捕捉到了 3,500 多次爆炸。 来源？爆破捕鱼——一种全球禁止的技术，使用装有炸药的塑料瓶来击晕并杀死 90 英尺半径内的所有物体。从黎巴嫩、利比亚到巴西和厄瓜多尔，至少有 34 个国家记录了这种极具破坏性的做法。 虽然渔民主要使用这种方法捕捞鱼类并在当地市场出售（可以通过内脏破裂和鱼鳔破裂来识别），但它也对色彩缤纷的珊瑚礁栖息地构成严重威胁。 该论文的主要作者本·威廉姆斯 (Ben Williams) 表示：“炸弹捕鱼很可能是该地区珊瑚礁消失的主要原因。”他指出，一枚炸弹就可以造成 200 平方英尺的破坏。 “这些风景如画的珊瑚礁变成了看起来像月亮的景观。它只是碎石和死珊瑚，几乎没有生命迹象。” 2023 年，来自英国和印度尼西亚的研究人员潜入海底，将价值 150 美元的录音机固定在海底的短木桩上。使用人工智能该团队现已将软件开源，他们在短短几个小时内搜索了 16 个月的音频，以识别可能的爆炸。 虽然 A.I.过滤掉可疑病例后，每个建议的声波都会被手动验证，以评估它是否源于炸弹或失火的船发动机。 由于声音在水中传播的速度比空气中传播的速度快四倍多，海洋科学家团队能够探测到 10 英里外的爆炸。 “当[炸弹]靠近时，声音非常大，可以把你震得浑身不舒服，”威廉姆斯说。 “但如果你把头伸出水面，你可能甚至看不到那艘船。” 考虑到暴风雨季节的挫折和鱼叉渔民篡改记录仪的情况，该团队计算出每年可能发生超过 8,500 次爆炸——所有爆炸都发生在仅 350 平方英里的区域内。 每 62 分钟投下一颗炸弹，...

title.en: Sydney shark attack survivor describes moment she came to face-to-face with ‘monster’
title.zh: 悉尼鲨鱼袭击幸存者描述与“怪兽”面对面的时刻

summary.en: Leah Stewart, a 34-year-old mother and teacher, shared her first interview after losing an arm in a shark attack at Sydney's Coogee Beach in June. She recalled that during the terrifying encounter, her primary thoughts were of her one-year-old daughter, which helped her endure the ordeal.
summary.zh: 34岁的教师兼母亲利亚·斯图尔特（Leah Stewart）在6月悉尼库吉海滩的鲨鱼袭击中失去了一只手臂，近日她接受了首次媒体采访。她回忆起那次恐怖的遭遇，称在被咬时她心中唯一的念头就是自己一岁的女儿，这支撑着她度过了难关。

body.en: In her first media interview since the June incident, Leah Stewart, 34, says her thoughts while being bitten were of her one-year-old daughter An Australian woman who lost an arm after a shark attack at a beach in Sydney’s eastern suburbs has recalled the moment she came face-to-face with the “monster”. Leah Stewart, a 34-year-old teacher and mother of a one-year-old daughter, was attacked by a large shark while on a morning swim at Coogee beach on 13 June. Continue reading...
body.zh: 34 岁的莉亚·斯图尔特 (Leah Stewart) 在 6 月事件发生后首次接受媒体采访时表示，在被咬伤时，她的脑海里浮现的是自己一岁的女儿。 一名澳大利亚妇女在悉尼东郊海滩遭遇鲨鱼袭击后失去了一只手臂，她回忆起自己与“怪物”面对面的那一刻。 6 月 13 日，34 岁的教师 Leah Stewart 是一名一岁女儿的母亲，她在库吉海滩晨泳时遭到大鲨鱼袭击。继续阅读...

title.en: One of the World's ‘Most Wanted’ Lost Fish Is Rediscovered
title.zh: 世界上最想要的一种丢失的鱼被重新发现

summary.en: On a vast network of rivers flowing through the jungles of Papua New Guinea, researchers have rediscovered the spinach pipefish, a relative of the seahorse, which had not been recorded in more than 40 years. The fish has long been sought after by conservationists, who feared it...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
On a vast network of rivers flowing through the jungles of Papua New Guinea, researchers have rediscovered the spinach pipefish, a relative of the seahorse, which had not been recorded in more than 40 years. The fish has long been sought after by conservationists, who feared it had gone extinct.

On an expedition that unfolded like a search for a missing person, researchers spent two weeks traversing the Sepik River and its tributaries, scouring villages and markets for evidence of the missing pipefish. They showed its photo to fishers, vendors, and village elders and asked where it might be found.

The task was daunting. The Sepik River extends across 700 miles of forests, floodplains, and wetlands along the northern coast of Papua New Guinea. “Travel is almost entirely by motorized boat or canoe, often taking many hours between villages,” said Jerrica Agebigo of the New Guinea Binatang Research Centre. The vast scale of the river system meant that scientists were heavily reliant on local knowledge.

In interviews, villagers consistently reported spotting a long, slender fish in the shallows of the Sepik River. Though they called the fish many names — Karuweng , Inap , Karuwena , Sako — their descriptions matched the profile of the missing species.

In the final days of the expedition, a fisher named Helen Asu managed to nab two pipefish using the handheld net she relied on to catch prawns. Researchers shared photos of her catch with Australian ichthyologist Gerald Allen, one of the last researchers to document the spinach pipefish in the 1980s. He confirmed the rediscovery.

“It makes my heart sing to hear that the spinach pipefish has been recorded anew,” said marine biologist Amanda Vincent, who chairs an expert group on seahorses, pipefishes, and seadragons for the International Union for Conservation of Nature. “To learn that the spinach pipefish still exists gives us hope that other ‘lost’ species are out there, too.”

The spinach pipefish had been named one of the 10 “most wanted” lost freshwater fish species by SHOAL, a U.K. conservation group. Its rediscovery highlights the urgency of protecting freshwater fish, the group said.

In interviews throughout the expedition, villagers reported declines of native fish, which are imperiled by mining, logging, and other threats. Globally, freshwater fish are under growing pressure. A recent U.N. report found that over the last half-century, populations of migratory freshwater fish have declined by 81 percent.
body.zh: 在流经巴布亚新几内亚丛林的广阔河流网络中，研究人员重新发现了菠菜尖嘴鱼，它是海马的近亲，这种鱼已有 40 多年没有记录。这种鱼长期以来一直受到自然资源保护者的追捧，他们担心它已经灭绝。 在一次像寻找失踪人员一样展开的探险中，研究人员花了两周时间穿越塞皮克河及其支流，在村庄和市场中搜寻失踪海龙鱼的证据。他们向渔民、商贩和村长展示了它的照片，并询问在哪里可以找到它。 这项任务是艰巨的。塞皮克河沿着巴布亚新几内亚北部海岸绵延 700 英里，穿过森林、洪泛区和湿地。新几内亚比纳唐研究中心的杰里卡·阿格比戈 (Jerrica Agebigo) 说：“旅行几乎完全依靠机动船或独木舟，在村庄之间通常需要花费很多小时。”河流系统规模庞大，意味着科学家严重依赖当地知识。 在采访中，村民们一致表示在塞皮克河的浅滩上发现了一条细长的鱼。尽管他们给这种鱼起了很多名字——Karuweng、Inap、Karuwena、Sako——但他们的描述与失踪物种的概况相符。 在探险的最后几天，一位名叫海伦·阿苏的渔民用她用来捕虾的手持网成功捕获了两条海龙。研究人员与澳大利亚鱼类学家杰拉尔德·艾伦 (Gerald Allen) 分享了她捕获的照片，杰拉尔德·艾伦是 20 世纪 80 年代最后记录菠菜尖嘴鱼的研究人员之一。他证实了这一重新发现。 国际自然保护联盟海马、海龙和海马专家组主席、海洋生物学家阿曼达·文森特 (Amanda Vincent) 表示：“听到菠菜海龙鱼被重新记录下来，我的心在歌唱。” “了解到菠菜尖嘴鱼仍然存在，让我们希望其他‘消失’的物种也在那里。” 菠菜尖嘴鱼被英国保护组织 SHOAL 评为 10 种“最想要”消失的淡水鱼类之一。该组织表示，它的重新发现凸显了保护淡水鱼的紧迫性。 在整个探险过程中的采访中，村民们报告说，由于采矿、伐木和其他威胁，本地鱼类数量减少。在全球范围内，淡水鱼面临着越来越大的压力。联合国最近的一份报告发现，在过去的半个世纪里，洄游淡水鱼的数量减少了 81%。

summary.en: David Kittredge conjures a true film lover's retrospective in this magical John Boorman documentary.

Editor’s note: This review was originally published on October 24, 2025 out of the 2025 Brooklyn Horror Film Festival. Yellow Veil Pictures will release the film at NYC’s Quad Cinema on Friday, August 28, with expansion to follow.

David Kittredge delivers a dazzling reflection on the career of John Boorman in the documentary “ Boorman and the Devil ,” a robust reframing of the legendary director’s “ Exorcist II: The Heretic ,” as strange and poetic as the disastrous 1977 production itself.

These days, Boorman’s much-maligned sequel to William Friedkin’s supernatural masterpiece is best known as a string of memes. You’ve got James Earl Jones dressed as a giant locust . Linda Blair tap-dancing her demons away . Even the film’s core concept of The Synchronizer, a baffling psychic invention from the script that not only vexed audiences but forced unionized crew members to debate whether the thing was a light or a prop. Related Stories ‘The Pitt,’ ‘All Her Fault,’ and More Among Nominees for The DARCYS 2026 Paul Thomas Anderson’s New Concert Film ‘Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall’ Sets Fall Roadshow Release

An embarrassment of riches for behind-the-scenes factoids, “Exorcist II: The Heretic” is a lot more than a punchline and as memorable as any real train wreck. If you already like the 1977 movie (and I’ll tell you right now, you should !), then “Boorman and the Devil” might not make the argument that it’s objectively good as fiercely as you’d like . But for those who hate “Exorcist II” or just haven’t seen it, Kittredge provides a sparkling on-ramp to New Hollywood history and Boorman’s astonishing career. (Note: The film also features IndieWire’s Jim Hemphill as a talking head.)

92 years old now, Boorman debuted in black-and-white with “Catch Us If You Can” (1965), before canoeing to the Oscars with Jon Voight in “Deliverance” (1972) and blasting off into batshit space with Sean Connery and a fur bikini for “Zardoz” (1974) . At the top of his game when he was offered the chance to direct the original “Exorcist” over Friedkin, the British cinephile declined, and embraced his own original and audacious visions instead. body.en:

Just when it seemed like the 2026 New York Film Festival lineup was complete, another major film has been added to the 64th edition.

“ NAZA ,” a new documentary about the war in Gaza from Israeli filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, will make its North American premiere at NYFF . The Lincoln Center screening will follow its world premiere at the Venice International Film Festival.

Abraham and Szor served as two of the four directors of the critically acclaimed (and inevitably controversial) 2024 documentary “No Other Land.” They shared directing duties with Palestinian filmmakers Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal. That Oscar-winning film was notable for its collaboration between Palestinian and Israeli artists and its unapologetic support for the Palestinian cause. Related Stories Modern Hollywood Keeps Failing Looney Tunes. Will ‘Coyote vs. Acme’ Finally Get It Right? Universal Film, Focus Features Extend Partnership with Sundance Institute to Support Rising Filmmakers

While Abraham and Szor are working by themselves this time around, “NAZA” explores similar subject matter. Shot on the rooftops of Tel Aviv, the new film takes a closer look at the practices of the Israeli Defense Forces, taking its title from a military term for the number of civilian casualties that are expected from a given operation.

“NAZA” is produced by The Guardian and James Wilson for JW Films. Jonathan Glazer also serves as an executive producer on the film. Wilson notably produced Glazer’s most recent film, “The Zone of Interest.”

“’NAZA’ is an important investigative documentary about one of the gravest catastrophes of our time. The film brings critical information to light and, through its singular cinematic language, prompts broader questions of individual and societal complicity and accountability, especially in a time of intersecting global conflicts and endless wars,” NYFF artistic director Dennis Lim said in a statement. “Like many films in this year’s NYFF slate, it demonstrates cinema’s enduring ability to reflect and engage with the world around us.”

title.en: ‘Environmental violence’: inside the fight to save indigenous land from becoming a nuclear dumping ground
title.zh: “环境暴力”：在保护原住民土地免遭核废料倾倒的斗争中

summary.en: The new documentary 'To Use a Mountain' showcases the struggles and successes of indigenous communities resisting government plans to designate parts of the rural US as nuclear waste disposal sites. The film touches upon the complex history of nuclear energy, initially presented as a solution but fraught with safety...
summary.zh: 新纪录片《使用一座山》展示了原住民社区在抵制政府将美国乡村部分地区指定为核废料处理场计划中所经历的斗争和取得的成功。该片触及了核能复杂的历史，它最初被誉为解决方案，但却伴随着安全隐患和环境影响。

body.en: New documentary To Use a Mountain spotlights the pain and triumph of resisting government efforts to turn parts of rural US into disposal sites Nuclear energy was supposed to be our salvation, humanity’s chance to retool technology first conceived as a weapon of mass destruction into an engine of limitless prosperity. But even as the industry touted nuclear fission as an economic game-changer (never mind the astronomical startup costs ), a safety paragon (never mind the spills at Chornobyl , Three Mile Island and Fukushima ) and harmless fodder for an American comedy institution (never mind that glowing rod on Homer’s back or the three-eyed fish), there was no getting around the matter of what to do with all the toxic waste (never mind nuclear’s claimed green credentials). The stagnant state of that dirty business brought Casey Carter, the director of the new avant-garde documentary called To Use a Mountain , back to his interview with a Washington state farmer who was part of a class-action lawsuit against the government over the release of radioactive material from the Hanford nuclear reservation – site of the world’s first full-scale plutonium production reactor. The farmer’s words still echo, despite ultimately being cut to fit the film’s 90-minute runtime. “He joked that nuclear power is the only faith-based energy because everyone always asks, ‘Do you believe in it?’” Carter says. “He was like, ‘You don’t have to believe in solar. It’s just a pretty good idea.’” Continue reading...
body.zh: 新纪录片《利用一座山》聚焦了抵制政府将美国部分农村地区变成处置场的努力的痛苦和胜利。核能被认为是我们的救赎，人类有机会将最初被设想为大规模杀伤性武器的技术改造为无限繁荣的引擎。但是，尽管该行业将核裂变吹捧为经济游戏规则的改变者（更不用说天文数字的启动成本）、安全典范（更不用说切尔诺贝利、三哩岛和福岛的泄漏事件）和美国喜剧机构的无害素材（更不用说荷马背上的发光棒或三眼鱼），但仍然无法回避如何处理所有有毒废物的问题（更不用说核能声称绿色凭证）。这一肮脏行业的停滞状态让新前卫纪录片《利用一座山》的导演凯西·卡特回想起他对一位华盛顿州农民的采访，这位农民正参与针对政府的集体诉讼，该诉讼涉及汉福德核保护区（世界上第一个全面的钚生产反应堆所在地）释放放射性物质。尽管最终为了适应影片 90 分钟的时长而进行了剪辑，但这位农民的话仍然令人回响。 “他开玩笑说核能是唯一基于信仰的能源，因为每个人总是问，‘你相信它吗？’”卡特说。 “他说，‘你不必相信太阳能。这只是一个很好的主意。’”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary 'To Use a Mountain' brings to light the profound challenges faced by indigenous communities fighting to protect their ancestral lands from becoming nuclear dumping grounds. Their struggle is a powerful testament to the need to advocate for the voiceless and defend the vulnerable against potentially devastating environmental decisions. It...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《使用一座山》揭示了原住民社区在为保护其祖传土地免遭核废料倾倒而进行的斗争中所面临的严峻挑战。他们的抗争有力地证明了为那些不能为自己发声的人代言，并为了子孙后代和地球本身的利益，挺身而出对抗可能带来毁灭性环境决策的必要性。它促使我们思考，进步的代价由谁承担，以及为未来世代和地球本身发声的重要性。

verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

body.en: Film directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, co-directors of No Other Land along with Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal , investigates ‘Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians’ during the war A new documentary about Israel’s bombing campaign in Gaza, directed by Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor and produced by the Guardian, is to receive its world premiere at the Venice film festival. The film, called NAZA, has been produced with Jim Wilson and executive produced by Jonathan Glazer, the team behind The Zone of Interest, and is the only documentary that will compete this year for Venice’s prestigious Golden Lion. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导的电影，他们与巴塞尔·阿德拉 (Basel Adra) 和哈姆丹·巴拉尔 (Hamdan Ballal) 联合执导了《No Other Land》，调查了“以色列在战争期间有计划地大规模屠杀巴勒斯坦平民”。一部关于以色列在加沙的轰炸行动的新纪录片，由奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导，由《卫报》制作，将在威尼斯电影节上进行全球首映。这部名为《NAZA》的影片由吉姆·威尔逊 (Jim Wilson) 制作，并由《兴趣地带》(The Zone of Interest) 背后的团队乔纳森·格雷泽 (Jonathan Glazer) 担任监制，也是今年唯一一部角逐威尼斯著名金狮奖的纪录片。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary, "NAZA," premiering at the Venice Film Festival, seeks to bring to light the alleged "calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians" in Gaza. In a world where many suffer in silence, such efforts to investigate and expose injustice embody the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves. Yahweh's word reminds us of the...
reflection.zh: 这部名为《NAZA》的纪录片将在威尼斯电影节首映，旨在揭露加沙地带“以色列对巴勒斯坦平民的蓄意大规模杀戮”。在一个许多人默默承受苦难的世界里，这种调查和揭露不公的努力，体现了为那些无法为自己发声的人说话的呼召。雅伟的话语提醒我们，为贫困者的权利发声并确保他们的故事被听见，是一项道德责任。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.

title.en: ‘We’re barely above porn’: why would a film-maker choose to make a deliberately bad ‘mockbuster’?
title.zh: “我们几乎比色情片好不了多少”：为什么电影制作人会选择制作一部故意拍得很烂的“恶搞电影”？

summary.en: Filmmaker Anthony Frith directed a low-budget "mockbuster" in six days for the studio behind Sharknado, then created a documentary about the experience. The article discusses the critical reception of his intentionally "bad" film.
summary.zh: 电影制作人安东尼·弗里斯为《鲨卷风》背后的工作室，仅用六天时间执导了一部低成本的“恶搞电影”，随后又制作了一部关于这次经历的纪录片。文章探讨了评论界对这部他有意为之的“烂片”的评价。

body.en: With a tiny budget and six days, Anthony Frith directed a film for the studio behind Sharknado – and then made Mockbuster, a documentary about the experience Directors don’t tend to appreciate having their films eviscerated by critics. And us critics, well practised in lobbing proverbial grenades from the safety of our pretentiously book-lined, Cahiers du Cinéma-strewn offices, don’t tend to look an artist in the eyes and tell them that their work sucks. This is, however, exactly what I do to the Australian film-maker Anthony Frith. I’ve even prepared a zinger for the occasion. “Your film is a lemon that’s been eaten by a turkey then dumped into a vat of curdled mayonnaise,” I say. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯 (Anthony Frith) 用有限的预算和六天的时间为《Sharknado》背后的工作室执导了一部电影，然后制作了《Mockbuster》，这是一部讲述导演们不喜欢自己的电影被评论家挖空的经历的纪录片。而我们的影评人，在我们自命不凡的书籍林立、电影手册散布的办公室里，熟练地投掷众所周知的手榴弹，不会倾向于直视艺术家的眼睛，告诉他们他们的作品很糟糕。然而，这正是我对澳大利亚电影制片人安东尼·弗里斯所做的。我什至还为这个场合准备了一杯辛格酒。 “你的电影是一个被火鸡吃掉的柠檬，然后倒入一桶凝结的蛋黄酱中，”我说。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Anthony Frith's commitment to directing a film in just six days, even a "mockbuster" that he knew would face harsh criticism, highlights the intrinsic value of effort. Colossians 3:23 reminds us to work heartily, as for Yahweh and not for men, suggesting that the dignity of our labor comes from our intention and dedication, not solely from the outcome or...
reflection.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯仅用六天时间执导一部电影，即便他知道这部“恶搞电影”会面临严厉批评，他的这种投入精神突显了努力的内在价值。歌罗西书3:23提醒我们，无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给雅伟做的，不是给人做的。这表明我们劳动的尊严源于我们的意图和奉献，而不仅仅是结果或评论界的赞誉。这种视角能将最非传统或看似“糟糕”的项目，转化为有意义的努力。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: How the mob took Hollywood: the story of organized crime and the movies
title.zh: 黑帮如何掌控好莱坞：有组织犯罪与电影的故事

summary.en: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies looks back at how criminals insinuated themselves in the film business “From the foundation of Hollywood, organized crime is there.” So claims Tom Patterson, producer and director of new three-part documentary series,...
summary.zh: 纪录片《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮掌控电影业》回顾了犯罪分子如何渗透电影业。该三部曲纪录片的制片人兼导演汤姆·帕特森称：“从好莱坞创立之初，有组织犯罪就已存在。”

body.en: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies looks back at how criminals insinuated themselves in the film business “From the foundation of Hollywood, organized crime is there.” So claims Tom Patterson, producer and director of new three-part documentary series, Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies. Organized crime’s connection to the film industry actually predates Tinseltown, being present for the foundation of the medium itself, when inventor Thomas Edison sicced his hired goons on competitors in an attempt to maintain total control over early motion picture technology. As covered in Hollywood Crime Story, this resulted in said competitors – mostly Jewish businessmen from the east coast – fleeing westward and establishing the town and studio system that would become synonymous with movies as we know them. Continue reading...
body.zh: 《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮接管电影》回顾了犯罪分子如何潜入电影行业“从好莱坞的根基开始，有组织的犯罪就在那里。”新的三集纪录片系列《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮接管电影》的制片人兼导演汤姆·帕特森如是说。有组织犯罪与电影业的联系实际上早于好莱坞，当时发明家托马斯·爱迪生（Thomas Edison）为了保持对早期电影技术的完全控制，而雇佣了暴徒来对付竞争对手，这一点就为电影本身奠定了基础。正如《好莱坞犯罪故事》中所报道的那样，这导致上述竞争对手（主要是来自东海岸的犹太商人）向西逃亡，并建立了城镇和制片厂系统，该系统将成为我们所知的电影的代名词。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary "Hollywood Crime Story" reveals how organized crime, driven by the pursuit of wealth and power, embedded itself in the film industry from its very beginning, even with figures like Thomas Edison using "hired goons." This historical account reminds us that the love of money can indeed be a root of all kinds of evil, corrupting even creative...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《好莱坞犯罪故事》揭示了有组织犯罪如何从电影业的早期，甚至从托马斯·爱迪生使用“雇佣打手”开始，就因对财富和权力的追求而渗透其中。这个历史记载提醒我们，贪爱钱财确实是万恶之根，它能腐蚀社会中富有创造力和影响力的领域。这凸显了在面对非法利益的诱惑时，保持正直所需的持续警惕。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Mourinho review – if he didn’t want to open up, maybe he shouldn’t have starred in a docuseries …
title.zh: 穆里尼奥影评——如果他不想敞开心扉，也许他就不该出演纪录片……

summary.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film,
summary.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥主演了一部三集纪录片，由《兄弟：尖叫停止后》的创作者制作。别指望它会那么有趣……这部迷你剧的导演乔·珀尔曼之前的作品包括2018年那部揭露性十足又滑稽的电影，

body.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...
body.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥在《兄弟：尖叫停止之后》创作者制作的三部曲中担任主演。别指望它会这么有趣……在这部迷你剧的导演乔·皮尔曼 (Joe Pearlman) 之前的作品中，可以数 2018 年的一部具有启发性和搞笑性的电影《兄弟：尖叫停止后》。这部纪录片取得了出色的效果，因为它的主题看起来如此甜蜜，但严重缺乏判断力或自我意识，以至于他们所说的一切都像克里斯托弗·盖斯特（Christopher Guest）戏仿中的台词一样。他们无法自拔。就性格研究而言，传奇足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥是一个非常不同的冷鱼。和戈斯双胞胎一样，他确实非常认真地对待自己，但相似之处也仅此而已。他就像一本合上的书。 “你迫使我谈论我自己，”他在本系列最后一部分的结尾说道。 “而我不想。”这很公平，但它确实引出了一个问题：那么，为什么你会同意成为一个深入的三部分纪录片系列的主题呢？穆里尼奥在 Netflix 上继续阅读...

This reminds us that fame and public attention, like a refiner's fire, test a person's true character, revealing what lies beneath the surface. When given a stage, our authenticity is often put to the test, showing whether we are willing...
reflection.zh: 穆里尼奥的纪录片因他不愿真正敞开心扉而受到批评，尽管它提供了一个公共平台。这提醒我们，名声和公众关注，如同炼金的炉火，考验着一个人的真实品格，揭示其表象之下的本质。当我们被赋予一个舞台时，我们的真诚往往会受到考验，展现我们是否愿意被真实地了解。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Monsters of God review – a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers gets the Tiger King treatment
title.zh: 《上帝的怪物》影评：一场爬行动物走私犯之间的混乱恩怨，获得“虎王”式待遇

summary.en: A new documentary, "Monsters of God," explores the underworld of the animal trade through the lens of a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers. Director Eric Goode presents two figures whose intense rivalry and accusations are compared to the popular "Tiger King" series, highlighting the dramatic and often absurd...
summary.zh: 一部名为《上帝的怪物》的新纪录片，通过两位敌对爬行动物走私犯之间混乱的恩怨，探讨了动物贸易的地下世界。导演埃里克·古德呈现的这两个人物，他们之间激烈的竞争和相互指控被比作热门剧集《虎王》，揭示了这个非法世界中戏剧性且往往荒谬的冲突。

body.en: Director Eric Goode has found two enemies to rival Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin in his new documentary about the animal trade’s underworld Through the fear and general miasma of the Covid pandemic, TV brought people together like never before. Among the most-watched series of 2020 was of course Tiger King, Netflix’s hit about an improbably twisty feud between a gay, polyamorous big-cat breeder and convicted felon, and the conservationist rival whom he accused of murder (more specifically, of feeding her missing husband to the tigers in her sanctuary – which she denies). It was the perfect hit for quarantine: bold and ridiculous enough to get everyone talking, and with precisely no bearing on the grief and awfulness that was all around. Producer and co-director Eric Goode has made a smattering of Tiger King follow-ups since then, as well as another series, Chimp Crazy, about the self-described Dolly Parton of the primate world. His latest project – a co-production between his own outfit, Goode Films, HBO, and A24 – continues the theme, focusing this time on the reptile trade and taking its lead from the 2008 book The Lizard King by journalist Bryan Christy. It’s stuffed full of wild stories and even wilder characters: there are canny smugglers, underworld crime gangs, and even legitimate zoos that are said to have turned a blind eye to the provenance of their big, scaly friends. The series is centred on the US – although clearly the supply chain is global – and the two men who kickstarted the illegal trade: Hank Molt and copycat trader Tommy Crutchfield. Like Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin before them, there is no love lost between Crutchfield and Molt, and no odd biographical detail too trivial to skip over. Hank, says Tommy, “will turn anything good into bad”, while Hank reckons that Tommy is “one of the angriest and most bitter people I’ve ever met”. Along the way we learn that Hank used to be a mayonnaise salesman, and that Tommy worked at an extremely on-the-nose Florida establishment named Snake-a-Torium as a teenager, where he would later have his wedding reception. What follows is the story not only of their enduring beef and betrayals, but of other adjacent vendettas in the illicit reptilian market. Despite environmental concerns becoming increasingly en vogue in the late 60s, a “don’t ask, don’t tell” attitude still pervaded the world of wildlife trading, with many zoos happy to acquire what they needed from whoever happened to have it. There were, however, serious consequences for some of the creatures involved. With the police on his back, Molt once buried a stash of animals alive in New Jersey’s Pine Barrens, a location which would later become infamous via The Sopranos. When he was eventually arrested, Crutchfield would become the go-to...
body.zh: 导演埃里克·古德（Eric Goode）在他关于动物贸易黑社会的新纪录片中找到了两个可以与乔·异国情调（Joe Exotic）和卡罗尔·巴斯金（Carole Baskin）匹敌的敌人。在新冠疫情的恐惧和普遍的瘴气中，电视以前所未有的方式将人们聚集在一起。 2020 年收视率最高的剧集当然是《虎王》，这部 Netflix 热播剧讲述了一名同性恋、多角恋大型猫科动物饲养员和被定罪的重罪犯，以及他指控谋杀（更具体地说，将她失踪的丈夫喂给她庇护所里的老虎——她否认）的自然资源保护主义竞争对手之间的矛盾。这是隔离期间的完美打击：大胆而荒谬，足以让每个人都议论纷纷，却与周围的悲伤和可怕毫无关系。从那时起，制片人兼联合导演埃里克·古德制作了一些《虎王》的后续作品，以及另一部剧集《疯狂黑猩猩》，讲述了自称灵长类动物世界的多莉·帕顿的故事。他的最新项目——由他自己的公司 Goode Films、HBO 和 A24 联合制作——延续了这一主题，这次重点关注爬行动物贸易，并以记者 Bryan Christy 2008 年出版的《蜥蜴王》一书为主导。它充满了疯狂的故事，甚至更疯狂的人物：有精明的走私者、黑社会犯罪团伙，甚至还有据说对他们的大而有鳞的朋友的出处视而不见的合法动物园。该系列以美国为中心（尽管供应链显然是全球性的）以及发起非法贸易的两个人：汉克·莫尔特（Hank Molt）和模仿商人汤米·克拉奇菲尔德（Tommy Crutchfield）。就像之前的乔·异国情调和卡罗尔·巴斯金一样，克拉奇菲尔德和莫尔特之间没有失去爱情，也没有琐碎而无法跳过的奇怪的传记细节。汤米说，汉克“会把任何好事变成坏事”，而汉克认为汤米是“我见过的最愤怒、最痛苦的人之一”。一路上我们了解到，汉克曾经是一名蛋黄酱推销员，而汤米十几岁时曾在佛罗里达州一家名为 Snake-a-Torium 的非常引人注目的餐厅工作，后来他在那里举办了婚宴。接下来的故事不仅讲述了他们持久的争执和背叛，还讲述了非法爬行动物市场上其他相邻的仇杀。尽管环境问题在 20 世纪 60 年代末变得越来越流行，但“不问、不说”的态度仍然普遍存在于野生动物贸易领域，许多动物园乐于从碰巧拥有它们的人那里获得所需的东西。然而，这对一些涉及的生物造成了严重后果。莫尔特背着警察，曾在新泽西州的松林贫瘠之地活埋了一批动物，这个地方后来因《黑道家族》而臭名昭著。当他最终被捕时，克拉奇菲尔德将成为首选......

reflection.en: The documentary about rival reptile smugglers, likened to the "Tiger King" phenomenon, exposes a messy feud driven by intense rivalry and accusations. This kind of conflict often stems from a lack of humility, where individuals prioritize their own interests and perceived superiority. Yahweh calls us to a different path, urging us to value others above...
reflection.zh: 这部关于爬行动物走私犯之间激烈争斗的纪录片，被比作“虎王”现象，揭示了由强烈竞争和指控驱动的混乱恩怨。这种冲突往往源于缺乏谦卑，个人将自己的利益和自认为的优越感置于首位。雅伟呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们在分歧中也要看别人比自己强。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: Sumerian Pictures Acquires North American Rights to ‘Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt’
title.zh: Sumerian Pictures 获得“Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt”北美发行权

summary.en: Sumerian Pictures has acquired the North American distribution rights for "Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt," a documentary about the pioneering American rock band, The Butthole Surfers. The film, directed by Tom Stern, combines archival footage, animation, puppetry, and reenactments, and features...
summary.zh: Sumerian Pictures 已获得关于先锋美国摇滚乐队The Butthole Surfers的纪录片《Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt》的北美发行权。这部由Tom...

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

Sumerian Pictures has acquired North American rights to “ Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt ,” a salute to the trailblazing American rock band, The Butthole Surfers.

The film is directed by Tom Stern and combines archival footage, animation, puppetry, and reenactments featuring the band. In addition, Richard Linklater, Flea, Dave Grohl, John Paul Jones, Henry Rollins, and Ice-T are interviewed about a group that was known for combining psychedelia, punk and grunge with energetic, anti-establishment, often chaotic live shows.

“Tom Stern and team are taking us on a wild ride and we are excited to bring audiences to the incredible story of these punk icons,” Rob Williams, president of Sumerian Pictures, said. Related Stories New York City’s East Side Will Lose Yet Another Movie Theater with Imminent Closure of AMC Kips Bay Indie Star Joe Swanberg Never Really Left — but He’s Definitely Back Now

Sumerian is a newcomer to the indie distribution scene , but it turned heads with its acquisition of the 2026 Sundance Grand Jury Prize and Audience Award winner, “Josephine,” starring Channing Tatum and Gemma Chan. The film is seen as a potential awards season player .

Though it only got into the film business last year, its parent company Sumerian has been in the music and publishing game for 20 years. Recent and upcoming Sumerian Pictures films include Louis Paxton’s comedy, “The Incomer”; the romantic comedy “Mile End Kicks,” directed by Chandler Levack; and “Horsegirls,” directed by Lauren Meyering.

“The Butthole Surfers are one of the most mind-blowing stories in rock history. Our goal was to make a film that captured their essence, so the ecstatic reactions of film festival audiences have been deeply gratifying,” Stern said. “I’m thrilled Sumerian has joined forces with us to bring this experience to an ever wider audience.”

Williams negotiated the deal on behalf of Sumerian with Dan Braun and Matt Burke from Submarine. Winner of the SXSW “Best in Texas” award, the documentary audience award at the Philadelphia Film Festival, and the grand jury prize for best documentary at the Independent Film Festival Boston, “Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt” has been entertaining audiences at festivals around the country prior to its theatrical release this week as part of exclusive event engagements at Drafthouse Cinema....
body.zh: 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商也可能处理您的信息以帮助提供我们的服务。本网站受 reCAPTCHA Enterprise 保护，并适用 Google 隐私政策和服务条款。 Sumerian Pictures 已获得《Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt》的北美版权，这是向开拓性的美国摇滚乐队 The Butthole Surfers 致敬。 这部电影由汤姆·斯特恩执导，结合了乐队的档案镜头、动画、木偶和重演。此外，理查德·林克莱特 (Richard Linklater)、Flea、戴夫·格罗尔 (Dave Grohl)、约翰·保罗·琼斯 (John Paul Jones)、亨利·罗林斯 (Henry Rollins) 和 Ice-T 接受了采访，谈论了一个以将迷幻、朋克和垃圾摇滚与充满活力、反体制、常常混乱的现场表演相结合而闻名的乐队。 Sumerian Pictures 总裁罗布·威廉姆斯 (Rob Williams) 表示：“汤姆·斯特恩和他的团队正在带领我们踏上一段疯狂的旅程，我们很高兴能让观众了解这些朋克偶像的令人难以置信的故事。”相关故事随着 AMC Kips Bay 即将关闭，纽约东区将失去另一家电影院 独立明星乔·斯旺伯格 (Joe Swanberg) 从未真正离开过，但他现在肯定回来了 Sumerian 是独立发行领域的新人，但凭借查宁·塔图姆 (Channing Tatum) 和嘉玛·陈 (Gemma Chan) 主演的《约瑟芬》(Josephine) 获得 2026 年圣丹斯评审团大奖和观众奖得主，引起了人们的关注。该片被视为颁奖季的潜在选手。 尽管去年才涉足电影业务，但其母公司 Sumerian 已涉足音乐和出版行业 20 年。最近和即将上映的 Sumerian Pictures 电影包括路易斯帕克斯顿的喜剧《收入者》；钱德勒·莱瓦克 (Chandler Levack) 执导的浪漫喜剧《Mile End Kicks》；以及劳伦·迈耶林执导的《女骑士》。 “《屁眼冲浪者》是摇滚史上最令人兴奋的故事之一。我们的目标是制作一部捕捉其精髓的电影，因此电影节观众的欣喜若狂的反应非常令人满意，”斯特恩说。 “我很高兴 Sumerian 与我们联手，将这种体验带给更广泛的受众。” 威廉姆斯代表 Sumerian 与 Submarine 的丹·布劳恩 (Dan Braun) 和马特·伯克 (Matt Burke) 谈判了这笔交易。 《Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt》获得了 SXSW“德克萨斯州最佳”奖、费城电影节观众纪录片奖以及波士顿独立电影节最佳纪录片评审团大奖，在本周影院上映之前，作为 Drafthouse Cinema 独家活动的一部分，《Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt》一直在全国各地的电影节上为观众带来欢乐。

reflection.en: The news of a documentary about "The Butthole Surfers" receiving an award and distribution rights invites us to consider the cultural content we embrace. Philippians 4:8 encourages us to fix our thoughts on whatever is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, and admirable. As we engage with various forms of art and media, this verse offers a timeless guide for...
reflection.zh: 关于纪录片《Butthole Surfers》获奖并获得发行权的消息，促使我们思考我们所接纳的文化内容。腓立比书4:8鼓励我们将思想专注于真实、高尚、公正、纯洁、可爱和值得称赞的事物。当我们接触各种形式的艺术和媒体时，这节经文为我们提供了永恒的辨别指南，促使我们反思什么能真正丰富我们的思想和精神。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。
